description: The Bible editions available, with language and licence: osnb (Norwegian Bokmål), osnn (Norwegian Nynorsk), osen (English), oses (Spanish) are open CC BY 4.0 translations made by the free-bible project directly from the Hebrew and Greek; sblgnt (Greek New Testament), tanach (Hebrew Old Testament) are the source texts; kjv (King James Version, English), web (World English Bible), bsb (Berean Standard Bible, English), asv (American Standard Version, English), luther_1912 (Luther 1912, German), segond_1910 (Louis Segond 1910, French), rv_1909 (Reina-Valera 1909, Spanish) are public-domain translations.
